_healthy_comment: The healthy window is a SUBSET of the same payloads rather than a second file: healthy here means nothing reached the threshold and no verdict fell outside the grammar, which is a property of the window and not of a document. #9003 alone has one friction bullet, two in-grammar verdicts and no unlabelled bullet -- every key below the threshold of three and nothing off-grammar -- so every stats finding must be absent.
_comment: Shaped exactly as fetchWindow builds it: pr -> {body, comments:[{body}]}.
